title: MT-ProtBERT: Multi-task Learning ProtBERT for Intrinsically Disordered Proteins Classification with Scarce Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.25334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) differ from folded proteins in that they are dynamic, lack a stable three-dimensional conformation, and have low sequence similarity between similar proteins. The conformational heterogeneity of IDPs - while beneficial for their diverse functions - limits the use of traditional experimental tools to determine their conformation. The experimental difficulty, along with low sequence similarity, results in data scarcity, and makes it difficult to classify/detect IDPs that are similar or dissimilar, a task relevant to understand biology and evolution. We address this challenge using Multi-task ProtBERT (MT-ProtBERT), a multi-task extension of ProtBERT tailored for low-data regimes. MT-ProtBERT integrates Dynamic Window Masking, a Multi-Scale 1D Convolutional classifier (MS-Conv1D), and auxiliary objectives that jointly optimize masked language modeling and biochemistry-informed tasks. translated_title: MT-ProtBERT：面向数据稀缺场景的内在无序蛋白分类多任务学习ProtBERT
translated_abstract: 内在无序蛋白（IDPs）与折叠蛋白的不同之处在于它们是动态的、缺乏稳定的三维构象，且相似蛋白之间的序列相似性较低。IDPs的构象异质性虽然有利于其多样的功能，但限制了传统实验工具对其构象的测定。实验上的困难加上低序列相似性，导致数据稀缺，使得对相似或不相似的IDPs进行分类/检测变得困难，而这一任务对于理解生物学和进化具有重要意义。我们使用多任务ProtBERT（MT-ProtBERT）来应对这一挑战，这是专为低数据场景设计的ProtBERT多任务扩展。MT-ProtBERT集成了动态窗口掩码、多尺度一维卷积分类器（MS-Conv1D），以及联合优化掩码语言建模和生物化学相关任务的辅助目标。我们对这一方法进行了评估。
tldr: 提出MT-ProtBERT，一种专为数据稀缺场景设计的ProtBERT多任务扩展，通过动态窗口掩码、多尺度一维卷积分类器和生物化学辅助目标，实现内在无序蛋白的有效分类。
en_tdlr: MT-ProtBERT, a multi-task extension of ProtBERT tailored for low-data regimes, integrates Dynamic Window Masking, a Multi-Scale 1D Convolutional classifier, and biochemistry-informed auxiliary objectives to enable effective classification of intrinsically disordered proteins.
